1| package compact
2| 
3| // mergeFanIn is how many segments one merge cohort combines into a
4| // single output segment. Wider cohorts were measured to thrash the
5| // page cache on the slower shelves, so the width is a code constant
6| // rather than a tuning knob.
7| const mergeFanIn = 6
8| 
9| // cohorts slices the candidate list into fan-in sized groups, oldest
10| // segments first, deferring a trailing partial group to the next
11| // pass so every output segment has the same provenance shape.
12| func cohorts(cands []segRef) [][]segRef {
13| 	var out [][]segRef
14| 	for len(cands) >= mergeFanIn {
15| 		out = append(out, cands[:mergeFanIn])
16| 		cands = cands[mergeFanIn:]
17| 	}
18| 	return out
19| }
